sites.reason: The host is the publisher: LF_ConfigStream.Publish() builds the payload from the server's own loaded configs, which the host already reads directly. OnArrived only feeds a client's copy, so the host needs no local call (#2641).
A listen host draws plants through LF_Plants itself; the broadcast only fills a remote client's mirror (LF_PlantReplication header comment, #2819).
Same as LF_PlantBroadcastUpsert: the host's own LF_Plants meshes are removed by LF_Plants, the broadcast serves the client mirror.
Same as LF_PlantBroadcastUpsert: the host's own LF_Plants meshes are cleared by LF_Plants, the broadcast serves the client mirror.
